data.name: Arvith
data.gender_notes: Arvith is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Arvith is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Arvānd', which means 'rain'. In Hindu mythology, Arvith is often depicted as the god of rain. He is believed to bring life-giving rains to the earth, ensuring prosperity and fertility. The name Arvith carries the meaning “God of rain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arvith usually hope their child will grow to embody god of rain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
